Here is the complete, ordered picture of everything that fires when an owner is created via `POST /api/owners`.

## 1. Endpoint mapping

The mapping is split across a generated interface and the concrete controller:

- **Generated interface** `OwnersApi` (`target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/api/OwnersApi.java`) declares the mapping on the `addOwner` default method:
  - Line 52: `String PATH_ADD_OWNER = "/owners";`
  - Lines 79-86: `@RequestMapping(method = RequestMethod.POST, value = "/owners", produces/consumes "application/json")` with body param `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto`.
- **Concrete controller** `OwnerRestControllerV1` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`):
  - Line 73: class-level `@RequestMapping("/api")`
  - Line 74: `implements OwnersApi`
  - Lines 112, 135-136: `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` + `@Override public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto)`

So the effective route is `POST /api` + `/owners` = `POST /api/owners`, secured to role `OWNER_ADMIN`.

## 2. The controller method (full source)

`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`, lines 134-168:

```java
@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")
@Override
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    ownerFieldsDto.setAddress(addressNormalizer.normalize(ownerFieldsDto.getAddress()));
    rejectBlankOwnerFields(ownerFieldsDto);
    rejectDisposableEmailDomain(ownerFieldsDto.getEmail());
    boolean sharesHousehold = Boolean.TRUE.equals(ownerFieldsDto.getSharesHousehold());
    rejectInvalidPostcode(ownerFieldsDto.getCity(), ownerFieldsDto.getPostcode());
    rejectCityAtCapacity(ownerFieldsDto.getCity());
    rejectFutureRegistrationDate(ownerFieldsDto.getRegistrationDate());
    LocalDate registrationDate = businessDay(effectiveRegistrationDate(ownerFieldsDto.getRegistrationDate()));
    rejectDailyRegistrationLimit(registrationDate);
    String normalizedTelephone = telephoneNormalizer.normalize(ownerFieldsDto.getTelephone());
    ownerFieldsDto.setTelephone(normalizedTelephone);
    String normalizedEmail = emailNormalizer.normalize(ownerFieldsDto.getEmail());
    ownerFieldsDto.setEmail(normalizedEmail);
    HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
    owner.setRegistrationDate(registrationDate);
    owner.setCustomerCode(customerCode(owner));
    owner.setNamesakeCount(namesakeCount(owner.getFirstName(), owner.getLastName()));
    owner.setHouseholdId(householdId(owner));
    rejectDuplicateIdentity(owner);
    rejectHouseholdDuplicate(owner, sharesHousehold);
    owner.setPossibleDuplicateOf(sharesHousehold ? null : possibleDuplicateOf(owner));
    this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
    owner.setHouseholdSize(householdSize(owner));
    AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
        owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(),
        ownerMapper.membershipLevel(owner));
    OwnerDto ownerDto = toOwnerDtoWithDerivedFields(owner);
    headers.setLocation(UriComponentsBuilder.newInstance()
        .path("/api/owners/{id}").buildAndExpand(owner.getId()).toUri());
    return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerDto, headers, HttpStatus.CREATED);
}
```

Note: there is no `@Transactional` on this method. Each `clinicService` call is transactional individually, and all the "count existing owners" checks run as separate read transactions.

## 3. Request DTO and its Bean Validation annotations

`OwnerFieldsDto` (`target/generated-sources/openapi/.../rest/dto/OwnerFieldsDto.java`). Constraints are on the getters. Validation is triggered by `@Valid` on the interface param (OwnersApi line 86); the class is `@Validated` (OwnersApi line 44).

- `firstName` (line 76): `@NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$") @Size(min = 1, max = 30)` — required; letters only, up to 3 words separated by space/apostrophe/hyphen.
- `lastName` (line 97): `@NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$") @Size(min = 1, max = 30)` — same but allows a trailing period.
- `address` (line 118): `@NotNull @Size(min = 1, max = 255)`
- `city` (line 139): `@NotNull @Size(min = 1, max = 80)`
- `postcode` (line 160): `@Pattern(regexp = "^[0-9]{4}$")` — optional; exactly 4 digits when present.
- `telephone` (line 181): `@NotNull @Size(min = 1, max = 30)`
- `email` (line 202): `@Size(min = 1, max = 255) @jakarta.validation.constraints.Email` — optional; valid email when present.
- `registrationDate` (line 223): `@Valid` `LocalDate` (`@Nullable`, ISO date), optional.
- `birthDate` (line 244): `@Valid` `LocalDate` (`@Nullable`, ISO date), optional.
- `sharesHousehold` (line 265): `@Nullable Boolean`, no constraint — write-only create flag; never stored or returned.

There are no custom class-level or field-level custom validators on this DTO. (A custom `@PetAgeValidation`/`PetAgeValidator` exists under `rest/validation/` but applies to pets, not owners.)

## 4. Controller-layer manual validation, transformation, defaulting, derivation (in execution order)

These are private helpers in `OwnerRestControllerV1` invoked by `addOwner`. Bean Validation (section 3) has already passed before any of this runs.

1. **Address normalization** (line 137) via `addressNormalizer.normalize(...)`. `AddressNormalizer` (`rest/validation/AddressNormalizer.java`, lines 39-56): trims, collapses whitespace, upper-cases (Locale.ROOT), expands whole-word abbreviations `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`. The normalized address is written back onto the DTO before the blank check.
2. **`rejectBlankOwnerFields`** (lines 309-319): rejects whitespace-only `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` (closes the gap where `@Size(min=1)` passes for `"   "`). Collects offending names and throws `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` → 400.
3. **`rejectDisposableEmailDomain`** (lines 340-344): uses `DisposableEmailDomains.isDisposable` (`rest/validation/DisposableEmailDomains.java`, blocklist `mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`, case-insensitive domain after last `@`). Throws `DisposableEmailDomainException` → 400 naming `email`.
4. **`sharesHousehold`** flag captured (line 140).
5. **`rejectInvalidPostcode`** (lines 360-369): if postcode present, resolves `Region.forCity(city)` and checks `region.acceptsPostcode(...)` (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; unknown city accepts any 4-digit). Throws `InvalidOwnerPostcodeException` → 400 naming `postcode`.
6. **`rejectCityAtCapacity`** (lines 432-436): counts existing owners in the city (case-insensitive) via `countOwners`; if `>= 50` (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY`, line 419) throws `OwnerCityAtCapacityException` → 409.
7. **`rejectFutureRegistrationDate`** (lines 482-486): if supplied `registrationDate` is after `LocalDate.now()`, throws `FutureRegistrationDateException` → 400. Checked on the raw supplied value.
8. **Registration-date defaulting + business-day adjustment** (line 144): `effectiveRegistrationDate` (lines 465-467) defaults null to `LocalDate.now()`; `businessDay` (lines 499-508) rolls Saturday→Monday (+2) and Sunday→Monday (+1).
9. **`rejectDailyRegistrationLimit`** (lines 519-523): counts owners already carrying that `registrationDate`; if `>= 100` (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY`, line 455) throws `DailyOwnerRegistrationLimitException` → 429.
10. **Telephone normalization** (lines 146-147) via `telephoneNormalizer.normalize` (`rest/validation/TelephoneNormalizer.java`, lines 54-62): canonicalizes to E.164 (assumes `+61`, drops a leading `0`, strips non-digits), enforces 8-15 digits and per-country national length (`+61`→9, `+1`→10). On failure throws `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(List.of("telephone"))` → 400. Result written back to DTO.
11. **Email normalization** (lines 148-149) via `emailNormalizer.normalize` (`rest/validation/EmailNormalizer.java`, lines 28-30): lower-cases (Locale.ROOT), null left as-is. Written back to DTO.
12. **Map DTO → entity** (line 151): `ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto)` (see section 5).
13. **Set derived/defaulted entity fields**:
    - `registrationDate` = adjusted business day (line 152).
    - `customerCode` (line 153) via `customerCode` (lines 389-393): `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, REGION from `Region.code(postcode, city)`, HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex of SHA-256 of `telephone + lastName` (`hashPrefix`, lines 782-794).
    - `namesakeCount` (line 154) via `namesakeCount` (lines 406-409): count of existing owners with same first+last name (case-insensitive), pre-insert.
    - `householdId` (line 155) via `householdId` (lines 756-763): null when no postcode; else first 12 upper-hex of SHA-256 of `canonicalizeHousehold(lastName) + "|" + postcode`.
14. **`rejectDuplicateIdentity`** (lines 575-581): builds `identityKey` = `canonicalTelephone + "|" + email + "|" + householdId` (lines 652-658); if any existing owner has the same key, throws `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` → 409 naming `identityKey`.
15. **`rejectHouseholdDuplicate`** (lines 597-608): unless `sharesHousehold` is true or `householdId` is null, rejects if any existing owner shares the `householdId` → `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` 409.
16. **`possibleDuplicateOf`** (line 158) via lines 624-637: soft match — id of first existing owner with same last name (case-insensitive) and same postcode but a different canonical telephone; null when `sharesHousehold`. Stored on entity.
17. **Persist** (line 159): `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)`.
18. **`householdSize`** (line 160) via lines 748-754: post-insert count of owners sharing `householdId` (transient field, includes the just-saved owner).
19. **AUDIT log** (lines 161-163): logs to SLF4J logger named `"AUDIT"` — this is the only "event" emitted; there is no `ApplicationEventPublisher`.
20. **Build response DTO** (line 164) via `toOwnerDtoWithDerivedFields` (lines 287-296): sets `householdSize`, maps to `OwnerDto`, then sets `bulkSignupWarning` (lines 555-560; true when >80 owners share the day), `identityKey`, `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf`.
21. **Location header + 201** (lines 165-167): `Location: /api/owners/{id}`, `HttpStatus.CREATED`.

## 5. Service and mapper layers

**Mapper** `OwnerMapper` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`), MapStruct interface:
- `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` (lines 261-263): `@Mapping(target="id", ignore=true)`, `@Mapping(target="pets", ignore=true)`; straight field copy, no validation.
- `toOwnerDto(Owner)` (lines 22-36) computes many read-only derived response fields via default methods in the same file: `displayName`, `initials`, `telephoneDisplay` (240-257), `membershipNumber` (186-191), `checkDigit` (Luhn, 202-225), `membershipPoints` (121-137), `membershipLevel` (147-159), `locality` (101-108), `contactPreference` (45-47), `ageBand` (73-88). Note `initials` calls `substring(0,1)` on first/last name (assumes non-empty — guaranteed by prior validation).

**Service** `ClinicServiceImpl` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`):
- `saveOwner` (lines 232-237): `@Transactional`, delegates to `ownerRepository.save(owner)`. No validation/business logic.
- `findAllOwners` (lines 126-129): `@Transactional(readOnly=true)`, `ownerRepository.findAll()` — this is what every controller count/duplicate check calls.

`ClinicService` interface is at `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicService.java`.

## 6. Persistence layer

**Repository interface** `OwnerRepository` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java`) — plain interface, `save` at line 66.

**Active JPA impl** `JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `@Profile("jpa")`), `save` at lines 92-100: `em.persist(owner)` when id is null, else `em.merge`. There are also `springdatajpa` and `jdbc` implementations under `repository/` for other profiles.

**Entity** `Owner` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`), `@Entity @Table(name="owners")`:
- Column-level Bean Validation constraints (enforced by Hibernate's pre-persist validation listener on flush): `address` `@NotEmpty` (40), `city` `@NotEmpty` (44), `postcode` `@Pattern("^[0-9]{4}$")` (48), `telephone` `@NotEmpty @Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` (52-53), `email` `@Email` (57).
- `householdSize` is `@Transient` (lines 80-81) — not persisted.
- `pets`: `@OneToMany(cascade = CascadeType.ALL, mappedBy = "owner", fetch = FetchType.EAGER)` (line 86) — cascade all; irrelevant on create since the mapper ignores `pets`.
- Superclass `Person` (`model/Person.java`): `firstName` `@NotEmpty` (32-33), `lastName` `@NotEmpty` (35-37).
- Base `BaseEntity` (`model/BaseEntity.java`): `@Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)` (lines 33-35) — DB-generated id.

There are **no** `@Column(unique=...)` constraints, **no** `@PrePersist`/`@PostPersist`/`@PreUpdate` callbacks, **no** `@EntityListeners`, and **no** JPA auditing fields anywhere in `src` (grep for these returned nothing).
